options._comment: Configuration file for AMIP simulations with covariance matrix. See script for details and defaults
options.process_comment: Data already been processed so don't reprocess
options.cov_file_comment: Path for covariance file. If null then use default value
options.location_file_comment: Path for location file. If null then use default value
options.standard_time_comment: Start & end time as ISO std string or null for no start or end.
options.variables_comment: List of variables to use. If empty use all available.
options.regions_comment: Std List of regions to process.
options.special_regions_comment: Special regions for specific variables. If a region is not listed here it will use the default regions.
options.scales_comment: Scaling factors for specific variables. If a variable is not listed here it will not be scaled. Needed for matrix regularisation. Precip-> mm/day, AOD -> x100, Reff -> microns, MSLP_DGM -> hPa, CLDliq -> percent, CTP -> hPa
options.override_loc_comment: Override location values for specific variables.  Cess value is a climate sens of cira 2K.
options.help_help: show this help message and exit
options.files_help: List of files to read in. Must glob to at least two files.
options.config_help: Config file path whose values will overwrite default values but be overwritten by command line values
options.cov_file_help: File to write covariance matrix to as a csv file
options.location_file_help: File to write mean values to as a json file
options.metadata_file_help: File to write metadata to as a json file
options.scalings_file_help: JSON file where scalings to be written to
options.cov_time_help: Time range to use for covariance matrix. If not provided all years will be used
options.location_time_help: Time range to use for location values. If not provided same years as used for cov will be used
options.rename_help: A json dictionary of variable names to rename. E.g. '{"T2m":"T"}'
options.variables_help: Variables to use for covariance matrix. If not provided all common variables will be used.
options.exclude_variables_help: Variables to exclude from the calculations. If not provided no variables will be excluded.
options.regions_help: List of regions to process. If not provided all regions will be used.
options.special_regions_help: A json dictionary of variable names to list of regions to use for those variables. E.g. '{"T2m":["NHX_L","T_L"]}'
options.exclude_vars_files_help: a json dict indexxed by variable with list of file *names* to exclude.
options.mslp_vars_help: List of variables that are mean sea level pressure. These will be converted to delta from global mean values.
options.levels_help: A json dictionary of variable names to levels to use for those variables. E.g. '{"T":500}'
options.override_cov_help: A json dictionary of variable_regions to override/supplement the covariances values E.g. '{"netflux_global":1e-2}'. Off diagonal values will be zeroed
options.override_loc_help: A json dictionary of variable_regions to override/supplement the location values E.g. '{"Cess":2.0}'
options.block_help: Each variables is considered independent with only covariances within a variable calculated.
options.process_help: Whether to process the data or not.
options.scales_help: A json dictionary of variable names to scale the variables by. E.g. '{"Precip":86400}'
options.print_default_help: Print the default options and exit
